environment.description: Ktor 2.3.4 microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.27) with default pod security context. Service runs as non-root user (uid 1000) in a namespace with NetworkPolicy allowing egress to 0.0.0.0/0 on ports 80, 443, 53. Credentials are rotated every 60 seconds via a sidecar vault-agent injector (HashiCorp Vault 1.14), but the XXE vulnerability allows exfiltration of data before credential validation occurs in the request pipeline. JDK 17 Corretto runtime with default XML parser settings. No egress filtering beyond the permissive NetworkPolicy.
